title: Marketing site structure
question: Keep Mission Poster Cascade for /, take a challenger form, or re-roll. Visual identity stays Field Card (olive field, cream paper, Society orange, Syne + Outfit).

options.label: Mission Poster Cascade
options.lineage: Full-bleed website bands — one claim per act
options.thesis: The phone column dies. The landing is a cascade of full-bleed poster acts that prove the Society card, then stamp the CTA.
options.viewport: Edge-to-edge hero: Elevate Your Smoke as the brand plane, one line of proof, Start CTA. No phone shell. No inset media card.
options.risk: Too many stacked acts can feel like a long app scroll if bands stay narrow.

options.label: Cut-Paper Title Acts
options.lineage: Saul Bass title sequence grammar on Field Card colors
options.thesis: Scroll advances hard cut-paper acts — one idea, one silhouette, one CTA — like a Society title sequence.
options.case: Fuses cleanly with poster cascade topology; weaker Cigar Society / military identification than Field Card briefing culture.
options.viewport: Burnt-orange full field with black cut-paper PT silhouette and Syne brand; CTA as ink stamp.
options.risk: Can read as film titles, not Society PT, if silhouettes overpower the product facts.

options.label: Ascending Coil Courses
options.lineage: Coiled earth tower as vertical website courses
options.thesis: The page rises in coil courses — kickoff, card, leagues, boards — each seam a section join.
options.case: Progression clarity is strong; coil grammar fights the established olive/cream Field Card unless heavily translated.
options.viewport: Wide olive course with brand stamp; cream course below carrying the 9-minute phases as one band.
options.risk: Still vertical-only; may feel stacked rather than like a real wide website.

options.label: Station Bay Sequence
options.lineage: Darkroom stations as join → train → board path
options.thesis: Fixed stations in order: prove the offer, expose the card, develop the leagues, fix on live boards.
options.case: Fuses poorly because amber safelight overrides Field Card olive; path clarity is good, Society identification is not.
options.viewport: Wide station bay: brand + countdown as the expose timer; CTA commits the print.
options.risk: Metaphor noise if stations feel like a wizard instead of a marketing site.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A competent fitness challenge landing: wide nav, hero, feature grid, testimonials, FAQ, CTA — executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Full-width hero with brand and Start CTA; standard marketing sections below.
canonCard.risk: Reads like every other fitness landing if craft is only polish.
